learning_outcomes.text: Students who successfully complete this course will be able to understand the languages used on earth and the place of the Turkish language among world languages.
Students will be able to understand the structure of Turkish and the functioning of the language.
Students will be able to use their mother tongue better.
Students will be able to use science and knowledge better by mastering their mother tongue.

syllabus_topics: Content and purpose of the Turkish language course.
Languages in the World. The Place of the Turkish Language Among World Languages.
Language Families by Their Sources. Language Groups by Structure.
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language. Historical Development of the Turkish Written Language.
Old Turkish - Middle Turkish - New Turkish - Modern Turkish.
Current Status and Diffusion Areas of the Turkish Language.
Concepts of Culture and Civilization / Types of Culture.
Sentence Information - Characteristics of Word Groups.
